<!-- pr-reviewer: 5f0bce0da886fb972cceb1bd14df10f3cb48948f -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (the GUI check listed in the PR body is still a hand step).

**What looks good**
- The seed is written inside the same `SetOperationGeometry` command (`crates/app/src/commands/operation/geometry.rs`), so one undo restores pick and values. This is pinned by `the_pick_command_seeds_the_probe_and_one_undo_takes_both_back`.
- Prime Directive: no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new modules. Lookups use `.get()`, non-finite points are filtered, and every non-touchable pick is refused by name. These include a down-facing or tilted face, a bent or sloped edge, an inside corner, a cone, and multiple picks. `axis_of`/`against` refuse a Z- face rather than seeding a wrong direction (`probe_pick.rs:155-173,207-218`). The inside-corner test (`probe_pick.rs:329-332`) also stops a wrong corner touch.
- Layering is respected: no UI files touched, no new components, no project-format change. New files are 387 and 112 lines, under the ~400 limit. The decision file `docs/decisions/171-probe-from-pick.md`, the `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #171` are all present.

**Local results (merged with current main, clean trial merge, own target dir)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test probe_pick` | 9/9 pass |
| `probe_op` | 11/11 |
| `circular_pick` | 4/4 |
| `pick` | 9/9 |
| `vertex_pick` | 4/4 |
| `commands_undo` | 32/32 |
| `area_picks` | 5/5 |
| `heights_selection` | 9/9 |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- As the PR says, the pick does not check that a wall is taller than the touch depth. Generation's stylus check judges that, and `a_probe_created_from_a_pick_generates_clean` covers the clean cases. An open curved edge also has no fixture.
- Please do the one-Hub-run of a seeded probe the PR body mentions. Posted programs now carry the picked target, so confirm it on a real machine before relying on it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
